task_title: Live DuckBrain arm aborts 72 tests at setup with 503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED instead of classifying concurrent-writer contention
task_criteria: A 503 whose body carries code SERIALIZER_LOCKED on a live write is classified as environment contention: auger.py raises a typed SubstrateLockContended (SystemExit subclass) from insert/patch/delete_row/insert_decision/insert_edge and the pytest harness converts it into an attributed skip naming the lock and namespace, instead of SystemExit aborting fixture setup; every other 503 (auth, validation, unknown or missing code, non-dict body) and a non-503 status carrying the lock code still fails loudly as plain SystemExit, asserted by committed mapping tests red-proven against the pre-fix tree; with no competing writer the full gate ends GATE PASS with the same test count and live arms ran; the pytest summary attributes the skipped tests to the lock rather than collapsing one environment fault into a battery-wide error count.

items.criterion: A 503 whose body carries code SERIALIZER_LOCKED on a live write is classified as environment contention: auger.py raises a typed SubstrateLockContended (SystemExit subclass) from insert/patch/delete_row/insert_decision/insert_edge and the pytest harness converts it into an attributed skip naming the lock and namespace, instead of SystemExit aborting fixture setup; every other 503 (auth, validation, unknown or missing code, non-dict body) and a non-503 status carrying the lock code still fails loudly as plain SystemExit, asserted by committed mapping tests red-proven against the pre-fix tree; with no competing writer the full gate ends GATE PASS with the same test count and live arms ran; the pytest summary attributes the skipped tests to the lock rather than collapsing one environment fault into a battery-wide error count.
items.detail: (a) Classifier `_lock_contention` (auger.py:832-845) returns a message only for status==503 AND dict body AND code.upper()==SERIALIZER_LOCKED; `class SubstrateLockContended(SystemExit)` at auger.py:840; typed raises wired into insert (auger.py:868), patch (880), delete_row (1001), insert_edge (1313), insert_decision (5275). (b) Harness seam tests/conftest.py:105-110 catches only SubstrateLockContended and pytest.skip()s with 'substrate write contention (503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED, AUG-209): {exc}' — exc names the locked namespace; every other SystemExit propagates. (c) Mapping tests in tests/test_auger.py:2536-2586 assert all five verbs raise exactly SubstrateLockContended, isinstance SystemExit, message carries '503', 'auger-pytest-x', 'competing writer'; tests at 2588-2617 parametrize auth/validation/no-code/unknown-code/non-dict 503 bodies and 2623-2631 a 500 carrying the lock code, each asserting plain SystemExit and NOT the subclass. (d) RED-PROOF REPRODUCED: I created a worktree at pre-fix base 26b67b1, copied the new tests in, and ran `python -m pytest -k 'serializer_lock or typed_contention or not_the_lock or lock_still'` → `7 failed, 338 deselected` (decisive line: `AttributeError: module 'auger' has no attribute 'SubstrateLockContended'` at tests/test_auger.py:2617); same selection at HEAD → `7 passed, 338 deselected in 0.09s`. (e) No-competing-writer gate: prior tier1 run at HEAD exited 0 with `883 passed, 3 skipped in 1055.60s`, `LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0`, `GATE PASS` — same executed count (886) and both live arms ran; my own focused run of the 7 new tests passed in 0.09s. (f) Summary attribution surface: tests/gate.sh:294 runs the pytest arm with `-ra`, so every skip reason (which embeds AUG-209 + SERIALIZER_LOCKED + the namespace, conftest.py:108-110) prints in the gate log instead of an unattributed ERROR count.

items.criterion: The committed mapping tests are genuinely red against the pre-fix tree, not just claimed red in a docstring
items.detail: Reproduced, not trusted: worktree at 26b67b1 (git worktree add /tmp/aug209-prefix 26b67b1) plus the d499323 test file → `7 failed, 338 deselected in 2.64s` with `AttributeError: module 'auger' has no attribute 'SubstrateLockContended'`; identical selection at HEAD → `7 passed, 338 deselected in 0.09s`.

items.criterion: The gate/pytest summary actually surfaces lock-attributed skips (reachability of the attribution line into the log a human reads)
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:294 `run_pytest_arm -q -ra` — the -ra flag makes pytest print the short summary with each skip's reason, and that reason carries 'AUG-209', 'SERIALIZER_LOCKED' and the namespace (tests/conftest.py:108-110), asserted by test_run_cli_converts_the_typed_contention_into_a_named_skip (tests/test_auger.py:2634-2665).

items.criterion: Back-compat: composite `except SystemExit` write paths keep pre-fix behaviour when the typed contention fires
items.detail: SubstrateLockContended subclasses SystemExit (auger.py:840), so all 25 `except SystemExit` sites still catch it — e.g. patch_or_rewrite's rewrite/restore ladder (auger.py:955, 969, 976) folds the contention message into its refusal text and still restores the row; the serve layer's 404/502 folding (auger.py:7523, 7543) is unchanged. The pre-existing pinned behaviour test test_a_refused_advance_warns_once_and_costs_nothing (tests/test_auger.py:9603) ran green inside the tier1 full gate (883 passed, exit 0).

items.criterion: Fixture seam reachability: a lock landing in fixture setup (ns/project/decided) converts to a skip rather than aborting setup
items.detail: The ns, project and decided fixtures all execute verbs through run_cli (tests/conftest.py:974, 993, 1030), and run_cli (tests/conftest.py:92-111) converts SubstrateLockContended into pytest.skip regardless of whether it fires during fixture setup or the test body — pytest then marks each dependent test skipped, not ERROR-at-setup.
